text: So the month of practices aimed at harmonizing the second chakra has come to an end. I hope that you practiced regularly and received fruits in the form of an expanded space of pleasures, greater relaxation, blissfulness. Perhaps your life has begun to play with new colors. Maybe even in terms of health something has changed for the better… And now I invite you not to lose the wave and continue the practices! For many years you have strengthened a certain way of thinking, values, habits, psychological clichés, and now you have only begun to free yourself from all of this, step by step discovering who you really are. Continuing to move in this direction will, of course, give you deeper results.
